title: Group fields in a hash
summary: A hash stores several named fields under one Redis key.
introduction: A hash stores several named fields under one Redis key. Your task: Read the pages field from the same hash.
learningObjectives: Read the pages field from the same hash.
Explain the example for group fields in a hash

blocks.text: A hash stores several named fields under one Redis key. It can hold a small record such as a book title and page count.
Use a local Redis server and redis-cli. Commands here use cma: practice keys only. Redis commands do not run in the site's SQLite playground. Do not connect these exercises to a production database.

blocks.code:
HSET cma:book:1 title "Moon Trip" pages 60
HGET cma:book:1 title
blocks.title: Group fields in a hash

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `HGET` needs both the hash key and the field name inside that hash.

blocks.text: The field lookup returns Moon Trip.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A hash field is inside a key. HGET needs both the key and field name.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Read the pages field from the same hash.
